snippet.title: Kowloon's Curse: Lost Report - v2.0 Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Prepare to return to Kowloon City in the free 2.0 update for Kowloon's Curse: Lost Report, available 16.11 on Steam.

The update will add: 
-New storyline and sidequests
-New areas to explore
-More NPCs to talk to
-Improved graphics


Follow Kowloon's Curse on Twitter: https://twitter.com/KowloonsCurse

Play Kowloon's Curse: Lost Report on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1161640/Kowloons_Curse_Lost_Report/
